description: Header file defining the interface for monitoring the health of an fsmonitor daemon process, including initialization, cleanup, health check loop, and asynchronous shutdown functions.

methods.name: fsm_health__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__loop
methods.description: Main event loop to monitor the health of the daemon process within the health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__stop_async
methods.description: Requests asynchronously for the health thread to shut down.
